chunks.text: Nvidia halts AI server shipments to four South-East Asian countries. The FT reports Dell and Supermicro told customers Nvidia won't authorise their orders. Washington is tightening export controls to stop China accessing AI computing. New US rules target Chinese firms renting Nvidia-powered cloud computing. Nvidia booked $104 billion in revenue through its Singapore subsidiary in 2025. A cloud executive told the FT it's causing sheer chaos. Would Gulf data centre builders rely on one chip supplier now?
